QUOTE: The product handlers import `ServerDataOperatorBase` as a type only. They are plugged in through the same `mix(...).with(...)` call, so they can use `this.batchRecords` and `this.processRecords` from the base.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords()`. It also ties the handlers to `ServerDataOperatorBase` through the mixins. It doesn't say the mixins are "constrained to extend" the base, but the type-only import of `ServerDataOperatorBase` and `this.batchRecords` from the base carry the same substance.
